title: Entitlement field vocabulary
description: Shapes shared by every message that names an entitlement field. Contract 2 states the wire shape by role: account and channel travel as booleans, every other role as a sorted list of strings, and an empty list is [] never null.

Role.description: What a field is; registry/roles.json says what each implies. One role per field.

FieldValue.description: One field's value: a boolean (roles account, channel) or a list of strings (every other role). A limit is a list of decimal strings: in desired, one value per role that sets it (such as ["0","5368709120"]), combined by the add-on; in state and observed, exactly one, the effective limit.

FieldValues.description: Field values keyed by field name, in desired, observed and state alike. Absent and empty differ: an absent key is unmanaged, an empty list is 'make it empty', except for a limit, where an empty list sets nothing and the app's limit stays as it is. In state and observed an absent key is unknown.

Unit.description: A unit from registry/units.json, a closed list the UI formats.

Duration.description: An ISO 8601 duration such as PT30S or P90D. Every duration a manifest or registry declares is one.

AccountId.description: The target's own stable, opaque id for an account (a uid, a UUID); survives a rename.
